Hi Sofia,

Our current Private VPC contract (expiring 2027-02-28) is up for renewal. Over the past year our analytics team has grown and we're seeing a sustained ~3x increase in inference load. We need to renew and expand capacity, and we have two firm requirements:

- A separate, isolated analytics cluster in our Seattle VPC (strict tenancy isolation from customer-facing models)
- Staged provisioning: Seattle first (by end of Q1) with an EU replica later in the year

Can you share options/costs for adding a new isolated environment (approx. 8 x A100 equivalent GPUs initially, ability to burst to 12) and a recommended term structure? We also have to satisfy our security/compliance team: SOC2 artifact and a simple network diagram for the new cluster.

Please include a Mutual Action Plan we can attach to the renewal. Procurement is looped (procurement@elkmed.com) — they want a PO-ready quote.

Thanks,

Option A — Staggered provisioning (recommended):
- Phase 1 (Seattle): 8-gpu analytics cluster (dedicated tenancy) + 15% buffer for burst
- Phase 2 (EU): replicate configuration + routing/fallback after initial validation
- 24-month term with an option to convert to 36 months at a committed discount

Option B — Immediate full footprint:
- Both Seattle + EU live at provisioning (higher up-front cost, faster failover)
- 36-month preferred for best unit economics

I attached: RDW_SOW_ELK_v3.pdf (SOW draft), capacity_quote_ELK_2027.xlsx (PO-ready pricing). Also attaching a SOC2 summary we can share with your security team.

- Finalize SOW & price: by Jan 18
- PO & legal sign: by Jan 31
- Seattle provisioning start: week of Feb 14
- Seattle go-live (canary): end of Mar

Next steps from our side: internal alignment on the isolation topology and a quick runbook for staging. Would you be able to confirm preferred term (24 vs 36 months) so we can present a committed pricing sheet?

Thanks — I'll loop Marcus for infra details and Kimberly for commercial approval.
